_comment: December 2026 open groups: two Beginner AI Starter cohorts on Sunday nights, and one Intermediate AI at Work cohort on Wednesday nights. Advanced and Expert stay visible false until Q1 2027. Each run lists its own sessions. Beginner session 3 is 60 minutes (live clinic and wrap-up). startDate null shows 'Starts December 2026, exact dates coming soon'. Set startDate to YYYY-MM-DD and each session date and start (Israel time, such as 18:00) when they are fixed. cohortPaymentUrl is that run's pay link. enrolled counts paid seats out of capacity. status is open, full, or waitlist.

levels.name: AI Starter
levels.promise: Go from "where do I even start?" to using AI with confidence for real tasks every week.
topics: Get comfortable in a chat tool and write a clear prompt
Use it to draft, summarise, or plan a real task
A 60-minute live clinic and wrap-up on a task you will use this week
outcomes: Feel confident using an AI chat tool for everyday tasks.
Write clear prompts that get useful answers.
Use AI to draft, summarise and plan.
Know what's safe to share and how to check an answer.

levels.name: AI at Work
levels.promise: Turn hit-and-miss prompting into a personal prompt library and one reliable weekly workflow.
topics: A reusable prompt framework for a task you repeat
Work with a file, such as a PDF or a spreadsheet
Spot a weak answer and fix it
outcomes: Work with files such as PDFs and spreadsheets.
Build 2 to 3 reliable everyday workflows for your own work.
Spot and fix weak or wrong answers.

levels.name: AI Power User
levels.promise: Four weekly sessions to start a custom assistant or a simple workflow you will keep.
topics: Give the tool a file and a clear job
Build a custom assistant in your own account
Set up one simple automation and test it
outcomes: Build your own custom assistant (a custom GPT, Claude Project, Gemini Gem, or Copilot agent).
Set up your first simple automation.

levels.name: Agents and Automation
levels.promise: Four weekly sessions to build the first working piece of an agent or an automation.
topics: Map one repeated process and the check you need
Connect one tool the agent may use
Build the smallest version that does the job
Test it with non-sensitive sample data
outcomes: Design and build an AI agent for a real process.
Connect AI to your other tools with automations.
Test and improve an agent's reliability.
Leave with a working build and a plan to scale it.
